title: استکان چای
logline_fa: یک استکان چای داغ آرام‌آرام سرد می‌شود؛ بخار کم می‌شود، رنگ چای تیره می‌ماند و دست نامرئی دوباره پرش می‌کند: «دیر نشده، دوباره داغ می‌شود.»

protagonist.what: a clear tea glass (istikan) with saucer and a sugar cube
protagonist.build: 3 SVG layers: glass outline, liquid rect with clip-path, steam as 3 animated paths; level and colour are numbers driven by seek(t)
protagonist.state_change: hot amber and full steam at 0s, cold pale and still at 11s, refilled hot at 18s (same pose as 0s = loop)

emotional_arc: comfort -> neglect -> loss of warmth -> small rescue -> comfort again

beats.what: hot tea, steam rises, slow push-in
time passes with no clock: steam thins and liquid colour fades; sugar cube dissolves
cold: steam stops, glass looks lonely, light dims
a kettle spout enters from top, pours: level rises, colour returns, steam bursts

payoffs.viewer_gets: cube melts with a tiny ripple ring
a single silence gap, light drops

sound.anticipation: low pad sustains, then pulls out

payoffs.viewer_gets: last word lands as steam curls the same way as frame 0

sound.tail: fade matching frame 0 so the loop is seamless

assets: SVG glass, saucer, kettle spout, steam paths, sugar cube
kit sfx: water pour, glass tick, soft thud, warm pad

tests: state change driven by one variable (temperature)
likely_skill_gaps: no loop-seam gate (frame 0 vs last frame diff)
acceptance: pa audio-check: payoff offsets <= 5 ms, no clipping
loop gate: mean abs diff first vs last frame < 2%
lab.risk: low; the silence beat may trip dead-frame gates (false positive)
